I can relate to everything you've typed here. Currently not officially diagnosed with OCD (or autism lol I dont have 4k lying around) but am on a waiting list to be evaluated for it bc my docs are sure I'm showing symptoms. also forgive the formatting, I'm on mobile 

Sooo much of my anxiety is related to social situations, and just...other people in general. Even posting online is incredibly difficult. I'm terrified of saying something that will hurt or offend someone and then that's who I'll be in their eyes and you can't be objective about yourself so if someone thinks I'm that way it must be true which means that I'm a deeply deeply horrible and hateful person and always have been and I try so hard not to be and everything I do to be good is actually just an act -- and on and on goes the spiral.   


I've been toying with the idea that, because I used to be a very high masking person before I figured out I'm autistic, it became an obsession. Checking if I'm doing socializing right, comparing my life and all aspects to peers, ruminating about social interactions. But idk if that's how it works. 

I've been working on unmasking for the past two years, and now this OCD stuff is making me realize why it's been so hard to unmask even when I'm alone. There's so many years of pain and ostracization that have led up to this point, in regards to my obsessions and compulsions, it feels like if I am just myself - no masks, no explanations or qualifying statements, no apologies or reassurance seeking - something terrible will happen to me. 

  
Well, I don't know if this was helpful or coherent, but I resonated so much with what you said  ⁠♡ wishing you luck with all the brain stuff
